summary: Added 11 network boundary validation tests covering the server-authoritative simulation path (advance_sim + apply_input) under simulated latency/loss conditions. Tests verify determinism of the server path, prediction reconciliation under latency, input drop resilience (packet loss simulation), clock tracker with varied RTT values, hit validation at zero/bounded/excessive latency, and integration of the server path with firing. Also fixed a pre-existing CMakeLists.txt syntax error (missing closing parenthesis on target_link_libraries for ahamkara_ibl_tests).
